title: humboltia imraei
intro: Humboltia imraei, commonly known as a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, is a flowering plant native to India and other parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and skin infections. The health benefits of Humboltia imraei include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the skin.
